en.title: Get Minimum Time
en.description:
Carry the boxes of each floor to the top floor with separate round trips from that floor; each box requires one round trip plus 1 minute of loading and unloading.

The standard input/output format and supplementary bounds of this site are as stated in this problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤10^5); the second line contains n non-negative integers boxes[i] (≤10^9), where index i corresponds to floor i and the top floor is n.
en.output: Output the minimum total number of minutes (the integer may exceed 32 bits).
en.explanation: Each box on floor i takes `2(n−i)` minutes for the round trip and 1 minute for loading and unloading, so the costs simply add up linearly. Time O(n), constant extra space.
hints: Each box on floor i takes `2(n−i)` minutes for the round trip and 1 minute for loading and unloading, so the costs simply add up linearly. Time O(n), constant extra space.
